selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific class identity and rule out misclassification as similar utility vehicles.

Check if the ellipses of the wheels match the perspective of the scene. Also, inspect the 'golf bags' on the back—are they distinct objects or just black blobs fused to the cart? The foliage texture is also a key indicator of generative origin vs. real photography.
